scientific_question: Which high-speed flow region is strongest in the fireflow room flow field? Define high-speed locations as those at or above the linearly interpolated 90th percentile of non-zero speed values, where speed is the Euclidean magnitude of the stored uvw vector at each point, and treat locations that share an unstructured-mesh cell as one contiguous high-speed flow region. Use peak speed as the measure of strength, select the strongest region accordingly, and represent it by the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations. Report the peak-speed evidence and principal location, together with one relevant characterization of your choice: geometric relation, meaningful comparison, morphology, orientation, or spatial extent.
